excerpt.zh: 有关我们即将掀起叛乱的消息必须严密保守，不能让帝国及其麾下特工知道，越久越好。帝国的反谍报线人在整个星系范围内都成了被针对的目标。
excerpt.en: Knowledge of our impending rebellion must be kept from the Imperium and its agents for as long as possible. Imperial counterespionage assets are being aggressively targeted throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh: 有关我们即将掀起叛乱的消息必须严密保守，不能让帝国及其麾下特工知道，越久越好。帝国的反谍报线人在整个星系范围内都成了被针对的目标。
texts.en: Knowledge of our impending rebellion must be kept from the Imperium and its agents for as long as possible. Imperial counterespionage assets are being aggressively targeted throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh: 有关我们即将掀起叛乱的消息必须严密保守，不能让帝国及其麾下特工知道，越久越好。帝国安全总局的反谍报线人在整个星系范围内都成了被主动针对的目标。
texts.en: Knowledge of our impending rebellion must be kept from the Imperium and its agents for as long as possible. Assets of the Imperial Security Directorate are being aggressively targeted throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh: 星海帝国现已成功地撑过了席卷全境的暴乱风波！随着帝国重掌权威，公开叛乱的可能已经微乎其微。我们可以撤回特工了。
texts.en: The Imperium has somehow managed to weather the storm of turmoil and instability that was only recently sweeping across it! With Imperial authorities now firmly back in control, conditions are no longer favorable for an open revolt. Our operatives have been withdrawn.

label.zh: 我们现在应当等待时机……
label.en: We shall bide our time for now...
